caption: The drawing depicts a side view of a horse-shaped object with simplified and stylized contours, resembling a wooden or carved toy. The object is colored in rich shades of brown, with darker shading used to suggest form and gentle curvature, and slight highlights indicating the texture and shape of the surface. The mane, tail, and hooves are depicted in a contrasting light gray or white color. The horse stands on all four legs, with its head lowered and neck arched. The background consists of a plain, light beige or off-white color, with no additional objects or scenery present, and there are small, scattered brown marks or spots on the background surface.
title: Toy Horse
